The occupation therefore reads `none_recorded`, this dataset's own word for an absent record, rather than a trade reasoned from the company they keep — the absence is the finding. Cited at the Democrat of 17 June 1835, column 12. THE CORPUS GIVES AN ADDRESS IN THE TOWN — Lake Street — which is a placement no visitor passing through acquires. A scan read that confirms or corrects the name upgrades this entry.

age_band.note: AN AGE BAND, NEVER A YEAR. No source this project holds bears on when this person was born, so the band is drawn from the only committed sex by age distribution the project has - the 1840 Chicago schedule, five years after the scene and a town twice the size - seeded by this person's own id ('fell_j_w:age_bands_1840'). AND THE CONDITIONING IS THE MODEL'S, NOT A SOURCE'S: that a roll naming a person in their own right names somebody 15 or over. The 1840 schedule counts a child as a tally inside a household and never as a correspondent; 15 rather than 20 because an apprentice or a journeyman stands on a trade roll. No source states this rule. No exact year is written, because a year drawn from a decadal band would read as a record of a birth.

research_note: MINTED FROM THE NEWSPAPER REGISTER (T-0373) BY A RESIDENCY TEST, NOT BY A TRADE. T-0376's pass mints the register's `new_resident` people whose trade the papers print; this one takes the rest, where there is no trade to anchor anybody and a printed name on its own proves only that a Chicago paper set the type. The test asks the corpus two questions instead: does it place this person inside the town and NOWHERE outside it, and does a second independent witness corroborate a bare 'Chicago' — an address at street level, print in two or more issues, or print beside two or more people this reconstruction already holds. THE CORPUS GIVES AN ADDRESS IN THE TOWN — Lake Street — which is a placement no visitor passing through acquires. The household around them is a CONTAINER and not an argument: one member, no dwelling, no division, no family, no recorded trade, and every one of those absences written as unattested rather than filled in from the shape of the rest of the town. That the person is a HOUSEHOLD is the one invention here and it is recorded as docs/LIBERTIES.md L213. tools/mint_placed_residents.py derives the whole minted set and prints every candidate it refused, with the reason.
